title: Hy View House Jacob | KEY.co
description_expanded: The spacious main living area greets you with a modern, comfortable seating arrangement and abundant natural light pouring in from numerous windows. The 75-inch Smart TV and access to the deck with a private hot tub provide ample entertainment and relaxation options. The fully equipped kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, ample counter space, and a large waterfall kitchen island with seating for four. Adjacent to the kitchen, the dining area seats eight, perfect for family meals or gatherings. The upper-level master bedroom features a king-size bed, Smart TV, and an elegant private bathroom with dual sinks, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. Additional bedrooms and a bonus room offer cozy queen beds, desk areas, and shared modern bathrooms. Outside, enjoy the deck's hot tub, propane BBQ, and ample seating to take in the stunning views. With high-speed Wi-Fi and Smart TVs, every detail is curated for an unforgettable stay.
